name: v8y-theme-tsmom-y-2-gm
description: Y cell (lane YCOMB, task-YCOMB-report.md rule Y-2; runs only under the PM's Y registration; parent = the last accepted book whose fit carries a standardised composition, X-F0's theme-erc-v1 fit (X-5) or a later accepted one): composition schedule theme-tsmom-v1, every constant registered blind before any read. Hypothesis (Ehsani and Linnainmaa 2022, Journal of Finance 77(3), factor momentum; Gupta and Kelly 2019): a factor's own trailing one-year return predicts its next month, and factors after a losing year earn about zero; R-10, R-11 and theme-erc-v1 fix member or theme weights once from TRAIN, none moves a weight through time. Rule: theme sleeve r_t(d) = sum_{k in t} (w_k / W_t) s_k f_k(d) over the parent fit's role decisions (w the parent's final weights, f_k the fitter's factor series formed at d and realised at d + 2, flat 0); every 21 decisions from decision 254 (lookback 252, lag 3, step 21) a theme whose trailing sum T_t = sum of r_t over d = j - 254 .. j - 3 is not positive gets mass 0 and its mass goes pro rata to the other themes (all positive or none positive: the parent's masses; before decision 254, i.e. about 2020, the parent's masses); weights, signs, members and the per-date standardisation are the parent's; the IC runner re-applies the masses to the recorded sums (theme_schedule block; strategy_ic_theme_tsmom.cpp). No mean is fitted: each block reads the sign of sums realised at least 3 sessions before it, so the rule is walk-forward on the scored window. The change: fit --theme-tsmom theme-tsmom-v1 on the parent's fit argv (its --composition ew-theme-std-v1 or ic-shrink-v1, with or without --theme-erc; refused with --theme-resid and --era). Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Gross matching (Ruling PM6-6) applies: the schedule changes theme shares, not the book's scale, so it is judged at the parent's dollar gross; a calibration run at the parent's L (mechanics only: all-rows S2 gross G_cal, no return read), then the trial at L = L_parent x G_parent / G_cal (4 decimals) set by root as nav.leverage in a -gm copy. Identity before the cell: the parent's w argv re-run on the new build is byte-identical (flag absent); the parent's fit argv re-run gives the same composition_weights.json and admission.json except script_sha256; a file whose blocks all keep every theme reproduces the parent's combined signal byte for byte (ThemeTsmomRunner.*). Acceptance (PM7-34 default): paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics. Printed, deciding nothing: theme_blocks_off and theme_on_fraction (provenance.theme_tsmom), turnover per unit gross (tau_gmv_mean / mean_gross_leverage_all_rows, S2), cost per traded dollar, net annual return, net Sharpe at 4x NAV. Wave y-2 at matched gross (Ruling PM6-6, research_cycle.py wave): calibration at L 1.1828 gave all-rows S2 gross 0.9689836621 vs G_parent 0.9862134133; L = 1.1828 x 0.9862134133 / 0.9689836621 -> 1.2038.
